verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents user-configurable automations, scheduled jobs, or background agents in Amplitude. The embedded agent (docs-26) answers end users in-product, and the Experiment APIs callable from CI or scripts (docs-13) are developer building blocks rather than autonomous background automations. Third-party automation tools such as Fivetran are not Amplitude's own capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
